segments.title: Is sound FASTER or SLOWER on Mars?
segments.say: Is sound faster or slower on Mars? Pick one. Three. Two. One.

segments.title: SLOWER!
segments.say: Slower! About five hundred forty miles per hour on Mars.

segments.title: Earth: about 760 mph
segments.say: On Earth, at sea level, it's about seven hundred sixty.

segments.title: NASA blades beat it anyway
segments.sub: Rotor tips hit **Mach 1.08** in a Mars-air chamber
segments.say: NASA's test blades still beat it: Mach one point oh eight.

segments.title: 30% more lift
segments.say: That gave thirty percent more lift, for future Mars helicopters.
